messages:
Maria: putting this here to kick off a quick check — thinking about the Export CTA in the trace drilldown. current idea: small primary CTA in top-right of the trace header, and a secondary 'Download JSON' inside the export menu in the bottom rail. screenshot attached https://redwood.img/s/trace-export.png
Jasper: oof top-right feels busy. would prefer export in the flyout actions (right rail) so it’s grouped with other session actions. keeps header focused on navigation.
Akshay: agree with Jasper. also worried about keyboard order — if header CTA is first, it steals focus from the breadcrumb nav for keyboard users.
Vivian: +1 on grouping. also contrast: our current blue icon on white is 3.2:1 — fails WCAG for small icons. we should either increase contrast or add a visible label.
Lina: quick product thought — two user goals: fast download for debug (power users) and shareable permalink. can we make the primary action labelled clearly e.g. "Download trace" not just an icon?
Eli: for copy: "Download trace (JSON)" vs "Export session" — I favor explicit "Download trace JSON" for clarity in error debugging flows.
Maria: good points. proposal v1: move export to right rail actions. primary button reads "Download trace JSON" (text button, small). keep a subtle icon in header as overflow only. v2: leave a compact icon in header but make it secondary and not in the tab order until expanded.
DesignBot: accessibility note: recommended aria-label and role usage. suggested snippet:
```html
<button class="trace-download" aria-label="Download trace JSON">Download trace JSON</button>
```
Also add `aria-describedby` referencing a hidden status region updated on successful export.
Jasper: that aria snippet looks good. one more: add focus trapping for the export modal and return focus to the originating action.
Akshay: performance note — when users export large traces we should stream the JSON rather than blocking UI. pseudo:
```js
fetch('/api/trace/123/json').then(stream => stream.pipeTo(fileWriter))
```
so the button also needs a loading state label "Preparing download…"
Vivian: on contrast: if we keep icon-only in header, bump to 4.5:1 or add a 1px/1.5px outline on hover and focus. also add visible focus ring for keyboard users.
Lina: can we A/B test two placements for a week? metric: export click-through and time-to-download. if right-rail wins, keep it. if header icon gives faster success for power users, maybe keep both but deprioritize header in keyboard order.
Eli: copy nits: shorter label in UI, longer aria-label. UI: "Download JSON" — aria-label: "Download full trace as JSON for debugging". keeps UI tidy but accessible.
Maria: love that. next steps: Jasper to mock right-rail layout with small CTA and keyboard flow, Vivian to propose accessible color tokens, Akshay to spec loading/streaming behavior, Lina will define A/B metric, Eli will finalize copy & aria strings. I’ll iterate on the header overflow fallback. thanks :raised_hands:
Jasper: I'll drop a quick Figma file by EOD. ping @Maria if anything blocks.
Vivian: will post contrast tokens and updated specs in the thread.
Akshay: will draft streaming API proposal in #eng-runtime and link it here.
Lina: adding A/B to analytics board, linking hypotheses later.
Eli: sharing final copy in this thread when ready.
DesignBot: note created: design-issue-4312 (Trace export placement & a11y). Assigned: Jasper, Vivian, Akshay, Eli, Lina.
